head: VSCO desktop app for Mac: Studio Pro Desktop is out now
dek: VSCO has released Studio Pro Desktop, a Mac version of its Studio Pro photo editor, as a free download. It edits RAW photos in batches and comes with more than 200 presets.
details: Finished photos can be published straight to VSCO Galleries. VSCO says the full Studio Pro experience needs a VSCO Pro membership; its page doesn't list the price. Studio Pro is also on iPhone through the App Store. VSCO's page doesn't mention a Windows version.
where: Mac, free download from VSCO's website; iPhone on the App Store
means: If you edit many photos at once on a Mac, there's now a VSCO app made for that, with RAW files and the presets you may know from the phone app.
todo: Download it from VSCO's Studio page and try it free. Check what the VSCO Pro membership adds and costs before you pay.
thumb_words: VSCO STUDIO PRO COMES TO MAC
